lines.latin: Ángelus Dómini nuntiávit Maríæ.
lines.english: The Angel of the Lord declared unto Mary.

lines.latin: Et concépit de Spíritu Sancto.
lines.english: And she conceived of the Holy Ghost.

lines.latin: Ave María, grátia plena, Dóminus tecum; benedícta tu in muliéribus, et benedíctus fructus ventris tui, Jesus.
lines.english: Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee; blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus.

lines.latin: Sancta María, Mater Dei, ora pro nobis peccatóribus, nunc et in hora mortis nostræ. Amen.
lines.english: Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.

lines.latin: Ecce ancílla Dómini.
lines.english: Behold the handmaid of the Lord.

lines.latin: Fiat mihi secúndum verbum tuum.
lines.english: Be it done unto me according to thy word.

lines.latin: Ora pro nobis, sancta Dei Génitrix.
lines.english: Pray for us, O holy Mother of God.

lines.latin: Ut digni efficiámur promissiónibus Christi.
lines.english: That we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ.

lines.latin: Orémus.
lines.english: Let us pray.

lines.latin: Grátiam tuam quǽsumus, Dómine, méntibus nostris infúnde:
lines.english: Pour forth, we beseech Thee, O Lord, Thy grace into our hearts;

lines.latin: ut qui, ángelo nuntiánte, Christi Fílii tui incarnatiónem cognóvimus;
lines.english: that we, to whom the Incarnation of Christ, Thy Son, was made known by the message of an Angel,

lines.latin: per passiónem ejus et crucem, ad resurrectiónis glóriam perducámur.
lines.english: may by His Passion and Cross be brought to the glory of His Resurrection.

lines.latin: Per eumdem Christum Dóminum nostrum.
lines.english: Through the same Christ our Lord.

lines.latin: Amen.
lines.english: Amen.

lines.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, et Spirítui Sancto.

lines.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper,
